title: Adversarial design complete: Universal Media Decomposer API (8 turns)
body: 8-turn adversarial refinement completed for Universal Media Decomposer API. Artifacts: artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-adversarial-log.md (1006 lines; 8 sections: Proposed Approaches, Critique, Refined Approaches, Surviving Concerns, Implementation Patterns, Pattern Risks, Final Patterns, Open Risks & Human Questions) and input skeleton artifacts/designs/pending/DD-universal-media-decomposer.md (untouched, 72 lines). Outcome: Approach A (event-sourced semantic ledger in Postgres + replay-built projections) is the surviving lead; C (RDF-star claim graph) survives as challenger/projection; B (mutable Neo4j authority) and D (XTDB bitemporal authority) rejected as authorities with primary-source evidence (dual-write failure shape, CE no-HA/no-backup/no-RBAC; XTDB #5714 data-loss bug, WITH RECURSIVE unsupported). T7 required one re-spawn (first attempt returned mid-work without appending); retry succeeded. Citation spot-checks passed: XTDB #5714, Overeem et al. JSS 2021, Hatchet audit-logs docs, pgvector #875 — all real and accurately represented. No quality flags. Status: DONE.
